dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Hello. If you're here for an interview, I'll have to refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I'm a playwright and manager. I run the Zubayr Theater in this tree hollow.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: In addition, I also do some composing, choreography, stage design, and action direction.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: It's a small troupe. Pretty much everyone other than Kourosh wears several hats.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: So if it isn't about anything important, I'll have to ask that you not bother the staff here, including myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kourosh...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Him, he's a man of mediocre talent. His movements on stage are stiff and his singing is less in tune than Swoof's.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: His only strength is his determination. To this day, he still hasn't given up his job as an actor.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I'm a person with high standards, but I don't give up on persistent students. As long as he can still accept criticism, I'll continue to instruct him.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: After all, I can't expect everyone to be as gifted as Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Ah, that reminds me, I still have more to discuss with him regarding the lines of the new script...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Welcome, welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been going for you recently?

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Well, quite the same as always. I am the resident playwright and manager, and so I am... managing, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: We are a rather small troupe, so pretty much everyone other than Kourosh wears several hats. I also do some composing, choreography, stage design, and action direction on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: However, we have had new joiners recently, which has given me some time to focus on something... And of course, one can't complain about the added bustle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are Nilou and Inayah doing?

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Nilou is teaching her to dance as we speak. However, I must say that it hasn't been easy. Dance is something that is best learned from young, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Still, Inayah works so hard. Beyond the tasks that Nilou sets her, she trains independently as well.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I daresay that with her current progress, she may be good enough to take the stage in but a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I daren't imagine, however, how many times longer that period would have been without the tutelage of someone as gifted and patient as Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Do come again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kourosh...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Him, he's a man of mediocre talent. His movements on stage are stiff and his singing is less in tune than Swoof's.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: His only strength is his determination. To this day, he still hasn't given up on being an actor.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I'm a person with high standards, but I don't give up on persistent students. As long as he can still accept criticism, I'll continue to instruct him.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: After all, I can't expect everyone to be as gifted as Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Ah, that reminds me, I still have more to discuss with him regarding the lines of the new script...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: ...I've got work to do. Okay. Don't bother me unless it's an emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: You lost, now leave. I still have a lot of things to do.
